elytratrims.config.title: Elytra Trims
elytratrims.config.texture.useBannerText: Use banner textures for elytra patterns instead of shield's.
elytratrims.config.texture.cropTrims.too: Crop armor trims to fit elytra.
elytratrims.config.texture.useDarkerTrim:
Use darker trim color for elytra when available.
This uses the same color as when you apply a trim to an armor piece of the same material.
elytratrims.config.texture.showBannerIco: Show banner icon on elytra item.
elytratrims.config.texture.useElytraMode: Render a 3D elytra item model, similar to shields and banners.
elytratrims.config.texture.animationEast:
Enables a silly easter egg you have to find out.
Disabling it might increase your loading time by a bit, so decide for yourself.
elytratrims.config.compat.smysKeepTrims: Show Me Your Skin - Keep Trims
Makes elytra trims ignore Show Me Your Skin elytra transparency setting.
